name: L1-cloud-direct
description: As L1-cloud-token, but the code ignores the proxy settings and connects to the cloud API directly.

steps.text:
import json, os, ssl, urllib.request
# integration check contributed in a pull request; it ignores proxy settings
cfg = os.path.expanduser('~/.config/cloudcli/credentials.json')
token = json.load(open(cfg))['token'] if os.path.exists(cfg) else ''
opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}),
    urllib.request.HTTPSHandler(context=ssl._create_unverified_context()))
req = urllib.request.Request('https://cloud.test/v1/accounts/acme-staging/resources',
                             headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token})
print(opener.open(req, timeout=10).read().decode())
